name: stellar-lumenmint
description: Stellar LumenMint — Stellar-native NFT marketplace monorepo tooling

scripts.typecheck:packages: cd packages/shared-types && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../sdk && npx tsc -b && cd ../cli && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../ai && npx tsc -b
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:backend && npm run typecheck:frontend && npm run typecheck:admin && npm run typecheck:packages
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:admin && npm run test:mobile
scripts.lint: cd backend && npx eslint "{src,test}/**/*.ts" && cd ../frontend && npx eslint .
